test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct homonym from the given options to fill in the blank.

Nadia had an apple and a________for breakfast.
solution:
The correct answer is **pear**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** homonym to fill in the blank is '**pear**'.
 
• Considering *the other food item that is mentioned in the sentence is an apple, the other item will automatically be a fruit as well*.
 
• The word '**pear**' means *'a fruit that has yellow or green skin and is white inside. Pears are thinner at the top than at the bottom'.*
 
• Hence, the appropriate answer is '**pear**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Prier**- a curious or inquisitive person.
 
• **Pair**- two things of the same type that are used or worn together.
 
• **Pare**- to remove the thin outer layer of something.
